title: Sheet
description: The sheet over the canvas, an item's one page: its frame and the sections in it, its fields and how one is edited, the links picked on it, and the note being written. What keeps a person in control here stays protected (decisions e_gyzm7rj3, e_axz9au5f, e_dd7gdy8z); a root pack, so its parts change only through a root re-pin (task e_zhxd9bhb).
